snippet.title: DEEP STATE — Official Teaser Trailer | Immersive Action Game
snippet.description:
The deeper you go the darker it gets in DEEP STATE - a cinematic, immersive action game where paramilitary and paranormal collide. Travel the globe as you uncover the truth behind a top secret black project and its ties to your old partner who is seemingly back from the dead...

👽 Features: Old-school 3D graphics • Large open levels • Stealth • FPS action • Large arsenal of modern weapons & gadgets • Dark spy-thriller narrative with a cosmic horror twist

✅ Wishlist DEEP STATE on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2788210/DEEP_STATE/

❤️ Support development on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/c/FrogmanDev

💬 Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/HGtscRvB37

 🐦 Follow on Twitter/X: https://x.com/FrogmanDev

🎙️ Trailer voice acting by @JarrettRamond - available for hire on Fiverr: https://www.fiverr.com/jarrettraymond
